weakestArea: Tech is the narrowest category: the 6 tech slots skew crypto, with CoinDesk alone supplying 5 articles (13% of all output, the top source). Not cleanly actionable via the tunable levers (source caps already sit at 3 for standalone/RSS; CoinDesk's 5 came largely through event enrichment, not the standalone path), so this is an editorial-mix note rather than a parameter fault.

context: Healthy steady-state day on lighter news volume (38 articles): every freshness, diversity, multi-source, and sci-tech target met with margin, zero duplicates, and top-source share at 13% (well under the 20% ceiling). No active experiments and no pause gate. Prior reflection (2026-05-16 multi-source-floor revert) established that selector floors are tapped out for lifting multi-source rate — future sourcing gains must come from upstream feed coverage, not the floor lever. With metrics this clean, the correct move is to hold parameters steady rather than introduce a confounding variable.
